primary_population.rule: Strict-F_k eligible P1 dates, with upstream training and model-selection labels purged at split boundaries. Preserve584testtargets; all comparisons use the same eligible dates.

secondary_populations.raw_return_target_support: Both original raw prices P[t],P[t+1] present for that asset.
secondary_populations.raw_Vol20_target_support: All21 original raw prices P[t-19]..P[t+1] present for that asset.
secondary_populations.strict_full_model_input_plus_target: Task-specific secondary mask AND all120 raw price cells supporting the10x8 P1 input present:30price rows x4assets.
secondary_populations.strict_asset_input_plus_target: Diagnostic own-asset30price-row support; does not certify all8model inputs.
secondary_populations.matching_rule: For each asset/task/population, all compared models and naive denominators must use exactly the same target dates; report n.
secondary_populations.P0_P1_protocol_comparison: Target-only masks agree on shared target dates; input-support masks can differ. A strict cross-protocol comparison needs an explicitly common date subset.
secondary_populations.interpretation: Raw-present support is not proof of a fresh trade, true contemporaneous observation, or historical availability. No causal filling effect is estimated by masking fixed predictions.

known_event_quality_flags.BIST100_cancelled_session_2023_02_08: Separate support-level context flag; no automatic primary/secondary exclusion.

raw_metric_precision.truth: Canonical raw float64→ffill→log ratio→pandasrolling20sample_std(ddof1)*sqrt252; retain float64 raw scoring truth.
raw_metric_precision.predictions: Promote inverse-scaled values tofloat64 before subtraction and reduction; no silent float32truth rounding.
raw_metric_precision.training_tensors: May usefloat32 later; this does not redefine float64raw scoring truth.
raw_metric_precision.legacy_dtype_difference: Original03CSVfloat64 denominators and06float32raw targets/reductions were separate boundaries; new precision policy is explicit and shared by both loss arms.

validation_selection.P1_persistence_information: Latest admitted state t-1, not t.
validation_selection.zero_empty_denominator: Undefined with explicit status; do not epsilon-fill or silently average fewer assets.
validation_selection.nonfinite_neural_prediction: Reject checkpoint/run for primary validation; do not mask inconvenient failures.

incomplete_GARCH_rules.parameter_fit_or_bridge_failure: Preserve missing prediction and failure status; never substitute persistence.
incomplete_GARCH_rules.full_series_primary_pair: Requires complete predictions on the same584testtargets; otherwise mark asset/model pair incomplete. Selectionvalidation uses583dates.
incomplete_GARCH_rules.optional_matched_available_date_diagnost: Allowed only as a separately labelled comparison with common dates and explicit n; not a replacement for the primary pair.
incomplete_GARCH_rules.numerical_bridge_stability: Must satisfy its predeclared convergence checks. Synthetic validation does not guarantee all real fitted states will pass.
